info.name: PropVest — Live Workflow Tests
info.description:
End-to-end live tests for every PropVest workflow, run against a running API.

Run the folders **top to bottom** (Collection Runner) so tokens and IDs captured by earlier requests flow into later ones.

Setup before running:
1. Start infrastructure + API (see WORKFLOW_TESTING_GUIDE.md §2).
2. Import this file and the PropVest_Local environment.
3. Set `baseUrl` (default http://localhost:8081/api/v1).
4. For the Admin folder: promote a user to admin (guide §6), then re-run the Auth folder to mint a fresh token.

item.name: 11. Support tickets & transfer earnings (Phase 4.2/4.3)
item.description:
Live tests for the new support-ticket module and wallet transfer-earnings.

Run after folder 2 (Auth) so {{access_token}} is fresh. Items 8-10 need admin (guide §6).
Lifecycle model: users create/reply; agents (staff/admin) own the status. There is no user-side status change.

exec: pm.test('Open, and reply_count is 1 (opening message is the first reply)', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('open'); pm.expect(d.reply_count).to.eql(1); });
pm.test('Returns 422 validation_error (contract; used to be 400)', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(422); pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('validation_error'); });
pm.test('Field map uses Go field names', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().errors).to.have.property('Subject'));

item.name: Create ticket — category not in the allowlist (expect 422)

exec: pm.test('Allowlist is display labels: Withdrawal, KYC / Verification, Other, …', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(422); pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('validation_error'); });
pm.test('Our ticket is listed', () => { const t = pm.response.json().data.tickets; pm.expect(t.map(x => x.id)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('ticket_id')); });
pm.test('IDs do not leak existence: 404 ticket_not_found', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('ticket_not_found'); });
pm.test('Thread now has 2 replies', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.message).to.include('Any update'); });

item.name: Ticket detail (2 replies, still open; PATCH probe → 404)

exec: pm.test('Detail shows 2 replies and status still open', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.reply_count).to.eql(2); pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('open'); });

const patch = pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.environment.get('baseUrl') + '/support/tickets/' + pm.collectionVariables.get('ticket_id'), method: 'PATCH', header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + pm.collectionVariables.get('access_token') }, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ status: 'closed' }) } });
pm.test('No user-side status route: users reply, agents own lifecycle', () => pm.expect([404, 405]).to.include(patch.code));

pm.test('Agent sees who wrote in', () => { const t = pm.response.json().data.tickets; const mine = t.find(x => x.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('ticket_id')); pm.expect(mine).to.not.eql(undefined); pm.expect(mine.user.email).to.include('@'); });
pm.test('Status resolved; closed_at only stamped on closed', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('resolved'); pm.expect(d.closed_at).to.eql(null); });
pm.test('closed_at is stamped', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('closed'); pm.expect(d.closed_at).to.not.eql(null); });

item.name: User reply to a closed ticket (expect 409 ticket_closed)

exec: pm.test('Closed tickets accept no replies: 409 ticket_closed', () => { pm.expect([201, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code); if (pm.response.code === 409) pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('ticket_closed'); });
pm.test('No earnings maps to insufficient_earnings', () => { if (pm.response.code === 422) pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('insufficient_earnings'); });
